name: When Charm Fades
overview: After an accident, Xie Wan, the heroine of the bestselling novel Charm Never Fades, is transported into the real world and bound to a system that gives her one mission: make Jiang Shuo fall in love with her to open a portal back home. Confident in her romantic skills, Xie Wan dives in—only to discover her greatest weapon, her charm, no longer works.
